title: Meet Pod 6 Solo: A Pod sized for one
summary: Previous generations of the Pod were built around one assumption: a double-size bed, for up to two sleepers. With the introduction of Solo sizes with Pod 6, we’re bringing award-winning sleep technology to more setups and ways of sleeping than ever before.
body_markdown:
Previous generations of the Pod were built around one assumption: a double-size bed, for up to two sleepers. With the introduction of Solo sizes with Pod 6, we’re bringing award-winning sleep technology to more setups and ways of sleeping than ever before.


Solo sizes fit on Twin and Twin XL beds, as well as one side of a Queen, King, and California King, bringing Pod technology to solo sleepers, relationships where only one partner wants the Pod, younger sleepers (like teenagers), and smaller bedrooms.


### **Get the highlights**


- **** **** **** **** **** **New sizes:** Twin, Twin XL, and one side of a Queen, King, or California King


- **** **** **** **** **** **Same Pod:** Cooling and heating from 55°F to 110°F, sleep and health tracking, and Autopilot


- **** **** **** **** **** **Add a second side anytime:** Two Solo Covers zip together


- **** **** **** **** **** **Perfect for Solo sleepers and teenagers:** New Solo sizes are the ideal setup for one sleeper, or for younger sleepers 16+.


### **Made for the way you actually sleep**


**For one sleeper, on one side of the bed**


Whether you sleep alone or are in a relationship where only one partner wants the Pod, the Pod 6 Solo Cover makes it possible to bring cooling, heating, biometric tracking, and more to just your side of the bed.


**For smaller bedrooms and teenage sleepers**


For the first time, the Pod fits Twin and Twin XL, bringing better sleep to guest rooms, smaller bedrooms, and dorms. The Pod is currently recommended for ages 16+.


> *“For Solo, it’s the same heating and cooling and biometric tracking that you would get from the full-size Cover. This gives us the ability to offer our features to people who couldn’t have it before: teenagers, people living in college dorms or small apartments, as well as folks who only wanted thermoregulation on their side of the bed.”*
>
>
> — Sam Kang, Chief Product Officer


**For split mattress setups**


Split setups put two mattresses side by side. A standard Cover spans both, while the Solo sizes can fit each mattress individually. Just get one Solo Cover per mattress, and you both get the full Pod experience.


### **Redesigned to fit your bed**


Halving the Cover meant rethinking how it stays in place. Standard Covers rely on a fitted skirt to grip a mattress; cut that skirt in half, and there’s no longer enough surface for it to hold on. Our team replaced it with straps that wrap directly around the mattress, so a Solo Cover sits as securely on one side of a shared Queen as the original did on a bed of its own.


### **Start with one Solo Cover, add another later**


Two Solo Covers zip together to fit across the whole bed, each side with its own temperature and biometric tracking, both running on the same Hub. Start with one. Add a second whenever you’re ready.


### **Finally, a Pod sized for one.**


The first Pod for a Twin XL. The first that works on a split base. The first you can buy for one side of the bed and grow into two. Pod 6 Solo starts at $1,999.


### **FAQs**


**How do I add a second side?**


You can purchase a Secondary Solo Cover in the member shop, available roughly 60 days after your initial Pod purchase. The Secondary Cover will share a Hub with your original Solo, so it comes without a Hub. If your Solo is on one side of a Queen, King, or California King, the Secondary Cover in that size completes the bed. Two Twin XL Covers will also zip together into a King, but two Twin Covers don’t combine into a standard bed size.


**What is compatible with Pod 6 Solo?**


The Pillow Cover(s) work with every Pod 6 size, Solo included. The Blanket and Base pair with Standard Pod 6 only.
